description: This Dart source file defines a download controller for managing download items, including starting, removing, pausing, and restoring downloads. It interacts with a local database and a download engine to handle the download lifecycle.

classes.name: DownloadItem
classes.description: Represents a download item with properties like id, content information, status, progress, and timestamps. Provides methods to convert to and from database rows.

classes.name: DownloadController
classes.description: Manages download operations, maintains download state, interacts with database and download engine, and exposes methods to manipulate downloads.

methods.name: restoreFromDisk
methods.description: Restores download items and queue state from persistent storage, and resumes active downloads if not paused.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a new download item to the queue and starts its simulation if downloads are not paused.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a download item from storage and cancels its download.

methods.name: togglePaused
methods.description: Pauses or resumes all active downloads, updating the queue status and canceling or starting downloads accordingly.

methods.name: _upsertProgress
methods.description: Updates or inserts progress and status information for a specific download item in the database.

methods.name: _startSimulation
methods.description: Starts a download simulation for a given content ID, updating progress and status via the download engine.
